frames.headline: Write the math. See the answer.
frames.subline: Keep your notes and calculations on the same sheet.
frames.typedContent:
# Project estimate
rate = 85
hours = 12
subtotal = rate * hours
tax = 20% of subtotal
subtotal + tax
frames.captureNotes: Calculator; new sheet via Command-N. Precision 2, digit grouping on. Resize actual panel to about 1280x600 points on a 2x display. Show all lines and full result column; no selection or menus. Final result 1 224.00.

frames.headline: Change a number. Rethink the plan.
frames.subline: Variables keep the related calculations up to date.
frames.typedContent:
# Weekend budget
guests = 6
dinner = 180
ride = 36
(dinner + ride) / guests
frames.captureNotes: Final still uses six guests and result 36.00. For the video, begin with guests = 4 (result 54.00), then replace only 4 with 6. Do not add an equals sign or result to the input.

frames.captureNotes: Internet connected. Wait for genuine fiat and crypto rates to arrive. Show actual outputs and rate-source annotation. Inspect the source annotation and sanity-check the conversion outputs before capture. Settings has no live-rate status panel. Never use cold-start 1:1 fallback outputs, fixtures or manually replaced numbers. Source annotation uses smaller app text than sourceTextSizePx; inspect it in the finished frame separately.

frames.captureNotes: Use Calculator, not a fabricated cockpit view. Wait for a real report; show station, report and freshness indicator. Do not imply flight planning certification. Keep the complete readable report in view; if it does not fit, shorten the input to the first three conversion lines and change subline to 'Speed, pressure and time conversions for study and reference.' Update this manifest before rendering. Do not crop away stale/error status or type a fake METAR.
